34. A block of mass 5 kg resting on a horizontal surface is connected by a cord, passing over a light frictionless pulley to a hanging block of mass of 5 kg. The coefficient of kinetic friction between the block and the surface is 0.5, calculate the acceleration and the tension in the cord. (Ans: 2.5 ms-1 2, 37.50N)

35. In a certain men’s track and field event, the shot put has a mass of 7.30 kg and is released with a speed of 15.0 ms-1 at 400 above the horizontal over a man’s straight left leg. What are the initial horizontal and vertical components of the momentum of this shotput? (Ans: 83.9 kg ms-1, 70.4 kg ms-1)

36. Two skaters collide and grab onto each other on frictionless ice. One of them, of mass 70.0 kg, is moving to the right at 2.0 ms-1, while the other, of mass 65.0 kg, is moving to the left at 2.50 ms-1. What are the magnitude and direction of the velocity of these skaters just after they collide? (Hint; apply the law of conservation of linear momentum.) (Ans:-0.167 ms-1, the negative sign indicates that the skater moves to the left)

37. A 22-rifle bullet, travelling at 350 ms-1, strikes a large tree, which it penetrates to a depth of 0.130 m. The mass of the bullet is 1.80 g. Assume a constant retarding force, (a) how much time is required for the bullet to stop? And (b) what force, in newton does the tree exert on the bullet? (Ans: 7.4 ×10-4s, 848N)
